The thirty-third year of the Republic of China is 1944.　　Guo Moruo and Fu Baoshi were friends and teachers, with deep feelings. When Guo Moruo's birthday, Fu Baoshi often to their own pen of the best gift, for his birthday. The picture is one of them. The painting shows the scene described by Su Shi, the great writer of the Song Dynasty, "the former Red Cliff Fugue". Under the Red Cliff, the shore is broken for a thousand feet, the breeze is coming, and the river is flowing with sound. In the boat, there are three people sitting opposite each other, and Su Shi in the middle is holding wine on his chest, talking about his optimistic and open-minded view of life. The man on the right is holding a caveman and listening with bated breath. The monk on the left is stroking the boat, pondering. The wine jug and the accompanying dishes are already in a mess. The river water is flooded with microwaves, cascading and rippling away.　　The subject of "Chibi boat trip" has been painted by Fu Baoshi many times, each time different, each has its own strength. The layout of this picture is a mixture of reality and fiction, with the stone wall rising steeply, and the open river surface to form a strong visual contrast, unique.
